description.from: Design the standard normalized schema: sessions, messages, and typed content parts with a small fixed kind set (text, thinking, tool_call, tool_result, attachment, system) plus an extensible extra/raw passthrough. Every record carries timestamps, session/project identifiers, and source provenance (file, line or row). Done when the schema is specified, versioned, and round-trips through JSON.
description.to: Normalized schema in Rust with serde: Message, Role, Part (Text, Thinking, ToolCall, ToolResult, Attachment, System), Provenance, Timestamp, and raw passthrough via serde_json::Value for agent-specific fields. Specs first: features/02_schema/*.feature.
